title: Hong Kong Baptist University
description:
hkbu.edu.hk zoominfo.com/c/hong-kong-baptist-university/429650952 Hong Kong Baptist University (HKBU) is a leading public research university established in 1956 in Hong Kong.
It is highly regarded for its academic excellence, particularly in liberal arts, business, communication, and traditional Chinese medicine.
As one of the region's eight statutory publicly funded universities, it is dedicated to fostering global citizenship and innovative research.
